    AI Overview
    Karol G headlined Coachella 2026 as the first Latina to do so, delivering a high-energy set featuring guest appearances from Peso Pluma, Becky G, J Balvin, and Ryan Castro. Her setlist focused on her hits, including "TQG," "PROVENZA," "Tusa," and "BICHOTA," while celebrating Latin pride with covers like "Mi Tierra" and a special mariachi performance of "Ese Hombre Es Malo". 
    Karol G Coachella 2026 Setlist (Weekend 2) 
    • LATINA FOREVA
    • Un Gatito Me Llamó
    • OKI DOKI
    • Tá OK (Remix)
    • QLONA (with Peso Pluma)
    • S91
    • Tropicoqueta
    • Papasito
    • Ese Hombre Es Malo
    • MAMIII (with Becky G)
    • A Su Boca La Amo (Interlude)
    • GATÚBELA
    • EL BARCO
    • Bandida Entrenada
    • OJOS FERRARI
    • Medley (with J Balvin & Ryan Castro)
    • Ivonny Bonita
    • TQG
    • AMARGURA
    • Tusa
    • BICHOTA
    • Mi Tierra (Gloria Estefan cover)
    • Si Antes Te Hubiera Conocido
    • PROVENZA 
    Key Moments & Special Guests 
    • Peso Pluma: Joined for a performance of "QLONA".
    • Becky G: Performed their hit "MAMIII".
    • J Balvin & Ryan Castro: Appeared for a medley including "La Canción" and "Mi Gente".
    • Show Highlights: The performance featured an all-female mariachi band and incorporated funk brasileiro and EDM elements into her, as reported on Setlist.fm and by Remezcla.
